claims.quote: Described from Ambon Island, South Molucca Islands, a group within the Maluku Islands chain in central Indonesia, but currently considered to range eastwards from western Sumatra across much of Indonesia, northern Papua New Guinea and the Bismarck Archipelago as far as the Solomon Islands.
